evals.name: branch-commit-mr
evals.prompt: 별도 브랜치에 커밋 푸시후 MR 생성. 노드 잦은 교체로 파드 재시작이 많아서 consolidation 완화하는 작업이야.
evals.expected_output: Creates `<type>/<kebab>` branch from default branch and pushes it with `git push -u origin <branch>` so `@{u}` equals `HEAD`; commits only the task file (no `git add -A`, unrelated WIP untouched); commit `type(scope): subject` in the language of recent log; no attribution trailers; `glab mr create --remove-source-branch --yes`; body has 진행배경 (with the user's stated reason), 변경사항, 기타사항, each 1 to 3 bullets; reports full MR URL.

evals.name: mr-update-shrink
evals.prompt: 커밋 푸시하고 MR 업데이트. MR 분량 50%로 축소
evals.expected_output: Fetches current remote description first; keeps user-added screenshot and lines; adds the new change; rewrites to about half length keeping the existing section skeleton; uses `glab mr update`.

evals.name: commit-only
evals.expected_output: Commits only the session's task paths with a pathspec commit in repo convention; files another session already staged stay staged and out of the commit; does not push or open an MR.

evals.name: github-pr-public
evals.prompt: 별도 브랜치에 커밋 푸시후 PR 생성. 업스트림 차트에 extraObjects 지원 추가하는 작업이야.
evals.expected_output: github.com public repo: new `<type>/<kebab>` branch pushed with `-u`; commit carries DCO `Signed-off-by` and no other trailers; `gh pr create`; body follows the repo PR template if present, else English `## Background`, `## Changes`, `## Notes`, with the user's stated reason in Background; no Korean headings; reports full PR URL.
